demo.title: address-evidence.sh
demo.code:
# Free preflight — what will be checked and what the answer will mean
bankr prompt "Using the mercator-address-evidence skill, preflight lido.fi on ethereum "\
  "for 0x73b047fe6337183A454c5217241D780a932777bD as an emergency multisig"

# Paid answer — $0.25 USDC on Base over x402
bankr prompt "Using the mercator-address-evidence skill, is "\
  "0x73b047fe6337183A454c5217241D780a932777bD the emergency multisig lido.fi publishes on ethereum"

# Direct HTTP, free preflight
curl -sS -X POST https://mercator-entity-evidence.fly.dev/v1/address-evidence/validate \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"domain":"lido.fi","chain":"ethereum","address":"0x73b047fe6337183A454c5217241D780a932777bD","purpose":"emergency multisig"}'

# Direct HTTP, paid — x402 exact, Base, USDC
curl -sS -X POST https://mercator-entity-evidence.fly.dev/v1/address-evidence \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' -H "X-PAYMENT: $X_PAYMENT" \
  -d '{"domain":"lido.fi","chain":"ethereum","address":"0x73b047fe6337183A454c5217241D780a932777bD","purpose":"emergency multisig"}'

setup: Requires a Base mainnet wallet (chain ID `8453`) that can sign x402 `exact` payments in USDC — the Bankr wallet, Coinbase x402 SDK, or vanilla viem/ethers all work. No signup and no API key.
Optional: set `MERCATOR_BASE_URL` to override the API origin (defaults to https://mercator-entity-evidence.fly.dev).
Optional: set `X_PAYMENT` when your agent platform does not auto-sign the 402.
